decision_rule: The physical eight-operator Ritz span must beat the matched in-A1 isospectral scramble in median energy, median variance, and every paired square seed, while every physical square error is below 1e-5. The one-Lanczos result is mandatory context and this calibration alone cannot authorize an audit or N36.
